aliases: Pradhan Mantri Vikasit Bharat Rojgar Yojana
case_brief.what_it_is: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY) is a government scheme designed to promote job creation and the formalization of the workforce. It provides financial incentives to first-time employees joining the formal sector and offers wage-based incentives to employers who create net new employment.
case_brief.entitlement: Eligible first-time employees receive a total incentive of ₹15,000, disbursed in two equal installments of ₹7,500 each. The first installment is paid after 6 months of continuous service, and the second installment is paid after 12 months of service.
conditions: The employee must be joining the formal workforce (EPFO-registered) for the first time.
The employee must not have been a member of the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) on or before 31 July 2025.
The employee must have obtained their first EPF-registered job between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027.
The employee's monthly wage must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
The employee must complete 6 months of continuous service in the same company to receive the first installment.
The employee must complete 12 months of continuous service in the same company to receive the second installment.
The employee must remain in continuous employment and not switch to another job covered under the scheme.
common_failure_reasons: Failure to complete the required 6 months of continuous service for the first installment.
Failure to complete 12 months of continuous service for the second installment.
Switching jobs to another employer covered under the scheme.
Incorrect or missing Aadhaar-linked bank account details provided by the employer.
Employer failing to register or verify the employee details on the PMVBRY portal.

The letter will ask the office to check its records and explain, not claim the benefit as due.
